commands.explore: cd apps/desktop && FC_EXPLORE=1 pnpm exec vitest run tests/property/claude-*.property.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
commands.mutationDetect: FC_RUNS=<runs> FC_SEED=<seed> pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vitest run tests/property/<file> --maxWorkers=1 -t '<selector>'
commands.mutationReplay: FC_RUNS=<numRuns> FC_SEED=<seed> FC_PATH='<path>' pnpm --dir apps/desktop exec vitest run tests/property/<file> --maxWorkers=1 -t '<selector>'

samples.claude-jsonlines.property.test.ts: 100 normal / 1000 exploration; opens with two mandatory examples (byte-at-a-time multi-byte line; CRLF-terminated line + blank line + unterminated half-line with plans that cut between the \r and \n bytes)
samples.claude-state.property.test.ts: 100 normal / 1000 exploration per property; model-based driver applies the same pure timeline composition the controller applies per native event; the fail-closed sweep exhaustively runs all 22 single-field mutants on every execution; a dedicated property drives boundedRuntime with strings whose minLength exceeds each persisted bound, for every bounded field the runtime carries (512-char model/version/mode/effort and model/agent values, 4096-char cwd and plugin path, 2000-char capability/skill/argument hint, 1000-char model/agent/command/plugin/MCP/background-task names, 8000-char descriptions and MCP server info, 256-char plugin version and MCP/background-task statuses, 8192-char remote-control URLs); a further property forces the capability-count bound by generating a list of 1..24 capabilities beyond CLAUDE_STATE_LIMITS.runtimeCapabilities and asserting the persisted runtime keeps exactly the first 512 entries, so a dropped slice fails on the first sample.
samples.claude-settle-usage.property.test.ts: 100 normal / 1000 exploration per property; usage and cost examples are mandatory so dedupe/provisional/rebase rules hold every run, including provisional generation and summary snapshots and a summary event carrying a token field beside its cost; the ledger property drives the production accounting seam (applyClaudeUsageSample) rather than reimplementing it, advances an independent pending/recorded expectation from the generated events at every prefix and asserts the projection's pending map, the returned isNewGeneration flag and the settled projection against it, then compares the settled projection and the visible total as whole objects against an independent expectation so a field leaked into either is rejected even though no per-key check looks for it (a blanked provisional snapshot is invisible to the shape checks and fails only this input-derived comparison)
samples.claude-bart-usage.property.test.ts: 100 normal / 1000 exploration; tagged raw values decide window validity independently of the parser

cost.method: Claude per-file and exploration measurements below were recorded at 4e891bfe; their property and production source hashes remain unchanged. Each per-file wall measurement includes registry generation plus one Vitest process with --maxWorkers=1; medians use three sequential rounds. The shared whole-suite gate was remeasured after final Codex review and is recorded in property-governance.md and codex-property-evidence.json.
cost.exploration: FC_EXPLORE=1 (1000 samples) passes for all four files; the property suite filtered to this family by file path in one vitest process after the shared registry step (`cd apps/desktop && FC_EXPLORE=1 pnpm exec vitest run tests/property/claude-*.property.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`) is 3.50 / 3.49 / 3.64 s wall, median 3.50 s for 4 files / 11 tests, all 11 tests passing in every round. The family is selected by file path rather than by `-t claude`: the appendBounded property's title lacks the family word, so a title filter would run 10 of the 11 properties. The latest shared whole-suite baseline/candidate measurements are in property-governance.md.
cost.gate: Under the ~5 s per-file wall budget (0.76–1.09 s medians) and inside the ≤10 s-per-phase gate, which is read from the shared paired whole-suite legs in property-governance.md rather than from this family's exploration tier.

limitations: Pure in-memory families only: no native subprocess, no OS scheduling and no SQLite storage is exercised here. Native Handle behavior stays with native-harness.property.test.ts; persistence durability stays with storage.property.test.ts. The parser-mutation sweep enumerates single-field mutations exhaustively rather than generating arbitrary malformed states, and the model-based state driver mirrors the controller's per-event composition rather than running the controller; usage accounting, by contrast, is driven through the extracted production seam applyClaudeUsageSample. The model-cost delta sum is asserted with 1e-9 tolerance because the model subtracts per frame while the assertion adds emitted deltas, so IEEE754 rounding can differ at ~1e-13 (found and fixed in the oracle during 1000-sample exploration; the production contract itself is exact in real arithmetic). Every check/checkAsync property name equals its outer vitest it() title, and the recorded selector per fault is that shared title, so generated replay commands select exactly one test; a name that was not a substring of its it() title (as earlier revisions of these files had) would silently select nothing. Mutation runs used a pinned failing seed per fault at the FC_RUNS=100 tier, so re-running the recorded mutationDetect command reproduces the recorded detect log and counterexample exactly and the recorded mutationReplay command reproduces it at 0 additional shrink steps; detection seeds are drawn from the recorded runs and are negative for some faults, which fast-check accepts. Two faults are deterministic and therefore carry no seed or path: the exhaustive parser sweep, and the appendBounded head-retention regression, which the mandatory overflowing probe rejects before any generated value. The raw detect/replay/restored logs live under the gitignored .agents/local/property-faults/ scratch area, so only their SHA-256 digests travel with the repo; each digest covers the full vitest output for that stage. Every mutation was removed by restoring the exact original source bytes (SHA-256 verified against the pre-mutation digest, which is the hash of the file as delivered); no runtime fault switch is retained. The recorded propertySha256 values are the hashes of the delivered files at the time of this capture, so a later edit to a property file invalidates them and the evidence must be recaptured.
